tasks.title: Add slugify(str) utility to src/slug.mjs with node:test coverage
tasks.detail:
Implement a pure slugify(str) function in src/slug.mjs and cover it with node:test in src/slug.test.mjs.

=== src/slug.mjs (ESM) ===
Export a named function slugify(str). Transformation pipeline, in order:
1. Coerce/guard input to a string (String(str)).
2. Lowercase the whole string.
3. Trim leading/trailing whitespace.
4. Replace every run of non-alphanumeric characters ([^a-z0-9]+) with a SINGLE hyphen.
5. Strip any leading and trailing hyphens from the result.
Return the resulting slug string.

=== Behavioral acceptance criteria ===
- slugify("Hello World") === "hello-world"  (space -> single hyphen, lowercased)
- slugify("  Trim Me  ") === "trim-me"  (leading/trailing whitespace trimmed)
- slugify("Foo___Bar!!!Baz") === "foo-bar-baz"  (runs of non-alphanumerics collapse to ONE hyphen)
- slugify("---Edge---") === "edge"  (leading/trailing hyphens stripped)
- slugify("Already-slug") === "already-slug"  (single hyphens preserved)
- Numbers preserved: slugify("Version 2.0") === "version-2-0"

=== src/slug.test.mjs (node:test) ===
- Use import { test } from "node:test" and import assert from "node:assert/strict".
- import { slugify } from "./slug.mjs".
- At least 4 distinct assertion cases; recommend covering all bullets above.

=== Definition of Done ===
- Both files exist under src/.
- node --test src/slug.test.mjs exits 0 with all tests passing.
- slugify is a pure function (no side effects, deterministic).
- Builder hands to REVIEW when green; a reviewer closes it (builders never self-close).

notes.note: node --test PASS exit 0 (6/6). Files: src/slug.mjs, src/slug.test.mjs. Handed to SENTINEL for close.

CONTRACT ALIGNMENT: board spec requires export name slugify (my brief said slug). Renamed primary export to slugify(str), kept slug as alias. Tests now assert slugify + all 6 acceptance examples (incl. Version 2.0 -> version-2-0, Foo___Bar!!!Baz -> foo-bar-baz). RE-RAN: node --test src/slug.test.mjs -> exit 0, 8/8 pass, both from src/ and repo root.

SENTINEL review PASS. Independently ran: (1) cd src && node --test -> EXIT 0, 8/8 pass; (2) cd src && node --test slug.test.mjs -> EXIT 0, 8/8 pass. Security read of slug.mjs: pure/deterministic, no side effects, no eval/dynamic-require/IO/network, nullish inputs guarded, both regexes (/[^a-z0-9]+/g, /^-+|-+$/g) are linear-time with no nested quantifiers -> no ReDoS. Test file asserts all 6 acceptance bullets + edge cases. Closing as done.
